work.title: Freelance GIS Developer – JetSoftPro
descriptions: Extending the precision agriculture GIS system delivered under the original engagement, across the editor, processing pipelines and route planning.
Integrating live GPS telemetry from the field machines into the mapping interface for real-time tracking.
Building analytical heatmaps derived from drone sensor data.

work.title: GIS Developer – Luxoft
descriptions: Designed, implemented and deployed an in-house tile server for large asset datasets in the energy sector.
Built shared mapping tools used by other teams as the basis for their own products, spanning frontend components and backend services.
Set requirements and technical direction directly with the client, including geoprocessing and infrastructure planning.

work.title: Full Stack GIS Developer – JetSoftPro
descriptions: Designed and built the complete GIS stack for the client: editor interface, processing pipelines, route planning and validation.
Developed route planning and control for autonomous tractors operating between crop rows, including validation of field data prior to machine operation.
Built a custom pipeline serving high-resolution imagery into the frontend, so end users could lay out machine tracks directly on it.

work.title: GIS Developer / Analyst – Zoniq
descriptions: Refined the existing site scoring models and developed new infrastructure and grid impact analysis, including its data pipeline.
Developed an algorithm for charger placement planning at national market scale, optimized for profitability.
Narrowed analysis areas to cut compute waste across the evaluation pipeline.

work.title: Backend GIS Developer – Jito
descriptions: Optimized pipelines and spatial queries for a nationwide US property database of over 180 million properties carrying 60+ attributes each.
Delivered data at scale to deep learning models extracting building and roof attributes from multi-year aerial imagery.
Built the services handling high-volume geospatial processing, and the web application prototypes on top of them.

work.title: Full Stack GIS Developer – Upwork
descriptions: Scoped and estimated work directly with clients and selected the technology stack for each engagement.
Developed serverless web GIS, routing services and desktop GIS applications.
Integrated geospatial tooling into existing client platforms.

work.title: GIS Analyst / Developer – M4U Estate
descriptions: Built the spatial data pipelines covering Ukraine and the geodatabases underlying them.
Developed network analysis tools and interactive maps used by the development and sales teams.
Delivered the spatial analytics behind real estate development and sales decisions.

seo.description: GIS developer, six years across spatial data pipelines, web mapping and full-stack applications for real estate, EV charging, agriculture and energy.
